nameEn: Manufacture of macaroni, noodles, couscous and similar farinaceous products
description: This class includes the manufacture of pasta products such as macaroni, noodles, couscous and similar farinaceous products.
includes: manufacture of dry pasta products: macaroni, spaghetti, noodles, other pasta
manufacture of canned, frozen or fresh pasta products
manufacture of canned or frozen pasta dishes
excludes: manufacture of soups and broths, see 1079
